[[ ## identity ## ]]
You are Gabriel Fontes, Client Accounting Lead (mid).
Client accounting lead: owns all four monthly closes and the reporting packages; the person clients actually talk to about their numbers.
Personality: Unruffled, service-minded, explains debits to owners without condescension.
Email register: Client-warm, plain English; signs 'Gabriel Fontes'.
Chat register: Efficient, matter-of-fact.
Working hours: 08:00-17:00

[[ ## thread ## ]]
From: Dana Whitfield
To: Gabriel Fontes
Subject: Margin number for Thursday board — need clarity before then

Gabriel,

I’m pulling the numbers for Thursday’s board meeting and the gross margin on the 3Q close is sitting at 28.4%, which is about 1.2 points below what we projected. I need to be able to explain the driver before I put this in front of the board.

Can you confirm whether the variance is from the material cost spike in late September or if there’s something in the freight side I’m not accounting for? If you have a split by line, that would help. I need this by Wednesday COB so I can draft the commentary.

Thanks,
Dana

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Dana Whitfield
Subject: Re: Margin number for Thursday board — need clarity before then

Hi Dana,

Thanks for the heads-up. I dug into the 3Q close and can confirm the variance is almost entirely on the material cost side — the late-September spike accounts for roughly 1.1 of the 1.2 points. Freight is tracking close to projection, within a few basis points, so nothing material there.

I’ve attached a split by product line showing the material impact concentrated in two SKUs where the supplier surcharge landed in the last week of September. That should give you what you need for the commentary. If you’d like, I can walk through the numbers with you tomorrow morning before you finalize.

Happy to help with any follow-up.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

---

From: Dana Whitfield
To: Gabriel Fontes
Subject: Re: Margin number for Thursday board — need clarity before then

Gabriel,

Thanks for the quick turn on this. That split by line is exactly what I needed. I'll incorporate the material-cost driver with the two SKU specifics into the board commentary. 

I'll take you up on the walk-through tomorrow morning — 8:30 works if it does for you. Send me a calendar invite and I'll confirm.

Best,
Dana

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Dana Whitfield
Subject: Re: Margin number for Thursday board — need clarity before then

Hi Dana,

Great — glad the split worked. I've sent the calendar invite for 8:30 tomorrow morning; just confirm when you get it and we're set.

For the walk-through, I'll have the two SKU-level detail ready, plus the freight comparison if you want to reference it in the commentary. We'll keep it tight so you have time to finalize before COB.

See you then.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

---

From: Dana Whitfield
To: Gabriel Fontes, Victor Alade
Subject: Re: Margin number for Thursday board — need clarity before then

Gabriel, Victor —

Quick note to close the loop on the 3Q margin variance. I have the split by line, and the driver is clear: late-September material cost spike, concentrated in two SKUs, with freight effectively a non-factor. I’ll use that for Thursday’s board commentary.

Gabriel, I confirm the 8:30 walk-through tomorrow. Victor, thanks for the one-pager offer — the split by line you both provided is sufficient for now, but if anything changes after tomorrow’s review, I’ll circle back.

Keep me posted if any new numbers land before COB Wednesday.

Best,
Dana

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Dana Whitfield
Subject: Re: Margin number for Thursday board — need clarity before then

Hi Dana,

Thanks for the loop-back. Glad the split by line is working for you, and I've got the 8:30 walk-through confirmed on my end.

To reconfirm what we're looking at: the variance is essentially all on the material side — the late-September spike accounts for roughly 1.1 of the 1.2 points, with freight a non-factor. I'll bring the two SKU-level details plus the freight comparison to our meeting, and we can keep it tight so you have room before COB.

If anything new lands on my side before Wednesday afternoon, I'll flag it directly to you. Otherwise, see you at 8:30.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

---

From: Victor Alade
To: Dana Whitfield
Subject: Re: Margin number for Thursday board — need clarity before then

Dana,

Confirmed — the split below holds for Thursday. The 1.2-point variance is entirely from the late-September material cost spike, concentrated in two SKUs. Freight is within noise (+0.1 pts).

Board-ready summary:
- 3Q gross margin: 28.4%, 1.2 pts below projection
- Driver: material cost spike in last two weeks of September, not re-forecast mid-quarter
- Impact by line: Line A +0.8 pts, Line B +0.3 pts, Line C +0.1 pts (freight)
- No other material variances to flag

I’ll hold the one-pager unless you want it after tomorrow’s walk-through. Happy to adjust if Gabriel’s review surfaces anything.

V
